name: RepoFabric
description: RepoFabric is a self-hosted WinGet source platform for Microsoft-managed fleets. It provides Entra ID sign-in, one-click Intune policy export (DesktopAppInstaller CSP) to point endpoints to a private source, Azure Arc readiness, and a GUI admin console. It also offers a REST API and a 48-cmdlet PowerShell module, GitOps manifests, scheduled sync, and LAN peer-caching to reduce bandwidth.
author: Mark Ringo

securityCheck.aiSummary: RepoFabric.Client appears to be a legitimate endpoint-management module intended for use with Intune/Microsoft Graph workflows. The primary security considerations are: (1) optional CA trust and intranet-zone mappings that could reduce prompts and widen trust for self-hosted sources; (2) machine-wide profile modifications to add silent Winget wrappers, which could act as persistence vectors if misused; and (3) deployment templates containing placeholder secrets that must be replaced securely before production. No evidence of remote code download/execution, credential theft, or data exfiltration beyond health checks.
